create_testing_config: create a Testing pydantic model with timeout_hours and benchmarks list for a compiler gym test regime
iterate_benchmarks: iterate over test benchmarks using Testing.benchmarks_iterator with a CompilerEnv instance
iterate_benchmark_uris: iterate over test benchmark URIs using Testing.benchmark_uris_iterator with a CompilerEnv instance
get_testing_benchmarks: get a list of testing benchmarks from a CompilerEnv dataset with max_benchmarks and seed parameters
validate_benchmarks: validate and convert benchmark data into Benchmarks objects using the Testing model validator
